page.overview:
Who is Alain?

Alain is a major supporting character appearing in Pokémon the Series and the Mega Evolution Specials. He is Ash's main rival in the Kalos region, and the eventual Kalos League Champion after defeating Ash in the finals. In Pokémon Journeys: The Series, he was revealed to have become one of the eight best Trainers in the world within the World Coronation Series, currently being ranked 6th.

Alain is a tall, slim teenager with messy black hair and blue eyes. He typically wears baggy gray pants, a black leather jacket, black boots, a blue shirt with a white undershirt, and fingerless gloves. He also has a pale blue scarf that resembles the flames emitted from Mega Charizard X's mouth. Alain also wore a Mega Ring on his left wrist, given to him by Lysandre, but at the end of the series, turned it over to the authorities as evidence proving the crime committed by Team Flare.

His retains the same outfit, his clothes are now more fitted compared to before. He also wears a new Mega Ring on his left wrist.

Alain is a calm, silent-type figure, who shows little emotion and focuses his attention towards battling. Deep down, however, he does not wish to see the ones closest to him suffer, especially his best friend, Mairin. Alain also obeyed Lysandre's orders without much hesitation, since Lysandre was the one that equipped him with the Mega Ring and the Charizardite X Mega Stone. In addition, Alain despises losing, with his loss to Siebold inspiring his desire to defeat 10 Mega Evolution trainers to become stronger.
